books.title: Foundations of Folk Magic
pages:
Chapter I — The Cunning Path

European folk magic weaves intention, timing, and humble tools. Salt circles, candle dressing, and spoken charms form the practitioner's daily craft.

Chapter II — Correspondences

Rosemary guards thresholds. Bay leaf carries wishes to the wind. White candles invite clarity; black candles absorb what must not follow you home.

Chapter III — First Workings

A healing charm needs little more than focus and rosemary. Protection begins at the threshold — salt, flame, and a clear name for what you ward against.
